decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche application of the firm's core lighting know-how. Defence customers give long-term, specialised business that the firm can interpret and serve well, although its low visibility (only mentioned on the website, never given a page of its own) suggests limited strategic weight.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on accumulated lighting and certification knowledge. The 2019 LED replacement kit shows the firm is actively learning and improving the line.

The designer task light is a relaunch of an established, popular design, so it rests on existing market knowledge. It had a dedicated page in both 2018 and 2019, which indicates continued commitment, even though design lights have shorter cycles.

The pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core office-lighting competence, where it can readily assimilate customer feedback. It is still relatively recent and was shown on a page of its own.
The premium pendant luminaire extends existing luminaire know-how into a higher segment. That fit makes it easy to refine, though premium design products face somewhat higher portfolio-pruning risk.
